title: The Long Harbor
author: Lena Villalobos
blurb: Rosalind Kavanagh, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
